personality: 4 Tactile / Playful fused with 1 iOS-Native Clean
personality_one_liner: A friendly, welcoming business companion that makes inventory and sales feel effortless, pairing soft honey tones and rounded shapes with professional, data-dense utility.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for standard views, but tighter modular spacing inside data-heavy cards (POS, Inventory) to reduce scroll fatigue.

navigation: bottom_tabs with 5 items (Inicio, Inventario, Ventas, Gastos, Reportes) + a prominent floating central mic FAB overlapping the tab bar.

do's: Use on the floating Voice Assistant mic FAB background (tinted brandPrimary).
Use on the sticky summary total blocks in the POS screen.
Use on the bottom tab bar if content scrolls behind.
dont's: Do not use on dense inventory list rows or simple summary cards.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard providing a bird's-eye view of business health via summary cards and quick charts.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the summary cards grid.
states.empty: Kawaii toast mascot illustration with text '¡Bienvenido! Registra tu primera venta para ver tus números brillar.' + 'Nueva Venta' CTA.
states.error: Kawaii toast looking sad with 'Error cargando datos' and retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with 'Pan Administrador' branding and greeting. Time range selector (Hoy, Semanal, Mensual, Anual) as scrollable horizontal pills (brandTertiary active state). Top section: 3 prominent summary cards in a grid/stack (Cash vs Transfer balance, Income vs Expenses, Net Profit) using surfaceSecondary with large numbers. Bottom section: Miniature visual charts (sales line chart, expense pie chart). Generous 'xl' spacing between sections.

screens.name: Inventory
screens.purpose: A browse-and-find list surface to quickly identify stock status and categories.

states.empty: Kawaii toast holding a box: 'Tu inventario está vacío. ¡Agrega tus productos estrella!' + 'Crear Producto' CTA.

screens.layout: Header with search bar and horizontal scrollable category filter chips. List items use a tabular/card hybrid layout: thumbnail left, Name/SKU top, tabular numerals for Price (right), and a color-coded pill badge for stock status (In Stock - Green, Low - Warning Amber, Out - Error Red) directly below the title. FAB at bottom right (secondary to the central mic) for 'Add Product'.

screens.name: Product Form
screens.purpose: Create or edit a product with automatic margin calculation.

states.empty: N/A - Form is either blank for Create or pre-filled for Edit.
states.error: Inline input errors with red borders.

screens.layout: Single column scrollable form. Clean text inputs for Name, SKU, Category. Specialized 'Pricing' module: Input for Cost, a slider component for Margin percentage, and an auto-calculating large-text display for Final Sale Price. Sticky 'Save Product' primary CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Point of Sale (Ventas)
screens.purpose: High-speed order assembly and flexible checkout.

states.empty: Empty cart illustration (Kawaii toast with a shopping bag) in the cart area.

screens.layout: Split vertical hierarchy. Top 60%: Scrollable product catalog grid (2-col) with quick-add '+' buttons, plus an instant search bar. Bottom 40%: The 'Cart/Checkout' zone, which can expand via Bottom Sheet. Inside the cart: listed items with editable price fields (to allow custom haggled pricing per item), and a fixed, glassmorphism total block. Payment selector uses large segmented buttons (Efectivo / Transferencia / Mixto) before the sticky 'Cobrar' CTA.

screens.name: Expenses
screens.purpose: Quickly log money going out by category and payment method.

states.empty: Kawaii toast illustration: 'Aún no hay gastos registrados hoy.'

screens.layout: Simple segmented input. Top: Large amount input pad. Middle: Expense category chips (Rent, Inventory, Utilities, etc.) wrapped in a flex-row. Bottom: Payment method toggle (Cash/Bank) and sticky 'Registrar Gasto' CTA.

screens.name: Reports
screens.purpose: Deep dive into analytics with interactive visual charts.

states.empty: Mascot indicating 'No hay suficientes datos todavía'.

screens.layout: Similar to Home but expanded. Sticky time-range selector. Section 1: Bar/Line charts for Sales trends. Section 2: Donut chart for Expenses by Category with legend. Section 3: 'Top Products' list showing bestsellers. Use 'surfaceSecondary' cards for each chart container with 'md' padding.

screens.name: Voice Assistant Modal

states.empty: Initial state: '¿En qué te ayudo? Ej: Venta de 2 camisas a 50 soles.'

screens.layout: A half-screen modal / bottom sheet that appears when the central mic tab is pressed. Dark overlay (scrim). The sheet contains a large pulsing mic icon, a real-time transcript text area, and a confirmation card showing the parsed action (e.g., 'Registrar: Venta - 2 Camisas - $100') with a 'Confirmar' CTA.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided. Primary is Honey (#E89A3E), secondary/accent is Soft Blue (#4A90E2). Dark mode uses a Deep Navy/Slate background for an elegant feel.
Use 'Nunito' everywhere to ensure a friendly, approachable ('amigable') aesthetic, but keep font weights at 400 or 500 max per the prompt rules.
The central mic button should be a Floating Action Button (FAB) that visually overlaps the bottom tab bar. When tapped, it opens the Voice Assistant Bottom Sheet.
For multi-currency formatting, ensure you support S/ (Soles), $ (USD), $ (ARS), $ (COP) depending on locale, and use dots as thousands separators.
Implement the 'Pan Administrador' (Pan Con Miel) branding seamlessly, using the cute toast mascot image specifically in empty states, onboarding, and error screens.
In the POS (Ventas) screen, ensure prices are fully editable per line item, and handle the layout such that 60% of the screen is catalog selection and 40% is the cart/checkout bottom pane.
Do NOT use any shades of purple, indigo, or violet. The only allowed blue is the soft blue explicitly requested by the user (#4A90E2 / #5C9CE6).
